items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well we had Talbot, Slow Drag, Elton Pornell, George Lewis, Lawrence Moreira and myself. That was the old regular lineup.

ctx.x: Well we worked there for a couple of years. Who do you have in the band then?
Well we had Talbot, Slow Drag, Elton Pornell, George Lewis, Lawrence Moreira and myself. That was the old regular lineup.
